name: Cherry Petals
desc: Sakura petals tumble and foreshorten as they fall, drifting on a seeded breeze with bass gusts that scatter them sideways.

energy.doc: fall speed + petal size + gust response

style.doc: sakura=soft gradient petals no hard outline / ink=sumi dry-brush tonal strokes / riso=two-ink misregistration print / woodblock=flat ukiyo-e with hard outline / wire=contour wireframe only (abstract)
